title: NGS Library Preparation Protocol
author: Opentrons
materials: This protocol performs a custom NGS library prep with the Opentrons Thermocycler module. The protocol requires 2 manual pauses for user intervention. --- * [Opentrons Thermocycler Module](https://shop.opentrons.com/collections/hardware-modules/products/thermocycler-module) * [ISOFREEZE cooling block](https://www.fishersci.com/shop/products/isofreeze-pcr-sbs-rack-2pk/50999415) * [Thermo Scientific 96-well PCR plate 200µl](https://www.fishersci.com/shop/products/pcr-plate-96-well-low-profile-skirted-12/p-7184552#?keyword=ab+0800) * [Nunc 96-deepwell plate 2ml](https://www.thermofisher.com/order/catalog/product/260251#/260251) * USA Scientific 2-200ul tips mounted on Opentrons tiprack base ---
Upload your protocol into the OT App.

steps.title: Configure pipette mount and samples
steps.instruction: Enter the mount side for the P20 multi‑channel pipette and specify the number of samples to process.

steps.title: Arrange deck as per map
steps.instruction: Arrange the deck layout according to the provided deck map.

steps.title: Calibrate labware and pipette
steps.instruction: Calibrate the labware, tip rack, and pipette using the OT App; refer to the support articles for calibration tips.
